delta: content-card final flag: show_attachment / show_document / show_progress / show_checklist / show_link accept an optional boolean final (default false). A successful final:true call suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until turn/end, like ask_user/show_next_steps; a failed call and a missing/false final do not suppress. Mid-task updates under the same cardKey omit final.
The five p0 entries replace their upstream counterparts only to add that property and state the conditional turn-end; every other field and the upstream tool-catalog.json are unchanged.

p0.name: show_attachment
p0.description: Attach a file to the chat as an attachment card. Pass final:true on the wrap-up card: a successful final call suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends.

final.description: true = this is the wrap-up card; on success the host suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends. Omit or pass false for mid-task updates.

p0.name: show_document
p0.description: Show a document card (title, short summary, workspace path, on-page TOC, type label) for a document you created, edited or saved to the local library. Use it once per document, after the content exists — not for ordinary prose. Pass `toc` when you already know the headings; otherwise pass `parseHeadings:true` with `path` and the host reads the local file to build the TOC. `content` is for short inline documents without a file. The card is clickable and opens the full-screen preview. Pass final:true on the wrap-up card: a successful final call suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends.

title.description: Document title shown on the card.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the document.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path of the document.

content.description: Short inline Markdown when the document has no file yet.

toc.description: On-page headings (max 6). Omit to derive them from `path`/`content`.

parseHeadings.description: true = read `path` and derive the TOC headings from its Markdown.

kind.description: Document type; drives the footer label.

kindLabel.description: Custom footer type label (e.g. "研究報告") when `kind` is not specific enough.

fileName.description: File name shown in the footer (defaults to the path basename).

size.description: Optional human-readable size shown next to the type label.

final.description: true = this is the wrap-up card; on success the host suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends. Omit or pass false for mid-task updates.

p0.name: show_progress
p0.description: Show a progress card for work that takes longer than about 30 seconds or several tool calls: a title, optional summary, state/percent, up to 8 steps with per-step state, an ETA and a stable cardKey. Call it once when the work starts and once when it ends (the same cardKey updates the same card in place); do not use it for one-step work, for a plan that has not been agreed, or as a substitute for your answer. It does not end the turn unless final:true is passed; a successful final call suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends.

title.description: Name of the job, not a sentence (e.g. "Summarise 12 interviews"). Max 80 chars.

state.description: Overall state. Defaults to running; done forces percent to 100.

percent.description: Completion percentage; inferred from steps when omitted.

summary.description: One sentence describing what is happening now. Max 200 chars.

steps.description: Up to 8 steps. If there are more, the card keeps the first 7 and adds an "… N more" row.

label.description: Short imperative step name. Max 120 chars.

state.description: pending | active | done | failed | skipped. Defaults to pending; the first pending step becomes active when nothing is active.

detail.description: Optional right-aligned detail, e.g. "6 of 12". Max 60 chars.

eta.description: Human ETA (e.g. "about 2 minutes"). Do not compute timestamps. Max 40 chars.

cardKey.description: Stable key for this job; calling again with the same key updates the existing card. Max 64 chars.

final.description: true = this is the wrap-up card; on success the host suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends. Omit or pass false for mid-task updates.

p0.name: show_checklist
p0.description: Show a checklist card: a title plus 1-12 items, each with text and a done flag, plus an optional short note. Use it when the list itself is the deliverable or will be revisited: a release checklist, an agreed plan, acceptance criteria or errands. The user can tick items in the UI, and a footer button sends the ticking back to you as a message. Do not use it for your own internal todo list, for a set of choices (use ask_user), or for narrative steps inside an explanation. It does not end the turn unless final:true is passed; a successful final call suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends.

items.description: Checklist items. If there are more than 12, the card keeps the first 11 and adds an "… N more" row.

done.description: Whether the item is already complete. Defaults to false.

note.description: Optional secondary note (owner, due date). Max 80 chars.

summary.description: Optional one-line context under the title. Max 120 chars.

interactive.description: false renders a read-only checklist (no local ticking or send-back button).

final.description: true = this is the wrap-up card; on success the host suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends. Omit or pass false for mid-task updates.

p0.name: show_link
p0.description: Show 1-4 web links as a link-preview card (page title, site, one-line description, kind) instead of pasting raw URLs. Use it for sources you actually opened or were given: official docs, issues, pull requests or articles. Only http/https URLs. Never invent a title or description you did not see. Do not use it for local files (use show_attachment or show_document), for more than 4 links (summarise the rest in prose), or as the only content of a turn. It does not end the turn unless final:true is passed; a successful final call suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends.

links.description: Links to show. Invalid or non-http(s) entries are dropped; the card fails if none remain.

title.description: Page title; defaults to the site host. Max 120 chars.

site.description: Display domain (e.g. open.feishu.cn); defaults to the URL hostname. Max 40 chars.

description.description: One line describing what the page contains. Max 160 chars.

kind.description: doc | repo | article | video | tool | other; drives the tile glyph.

final.description: true = this is the wrap-up card; on success the host suppresses later assistant text and SendToUser until the turn ends. Omit or pass false for mid-task updates.
